Chapter 322: Chapter 18: The Great Escape (Please Subscribe)

“`

On the other side of the battlefield,

a monocled man from the Heiyuan Clan watched intently.

He had already commanded many Heiyuan Clan powerhouses to blockade every sector of the Battlefields of Different Races.

Once the blockade was complete, the entire battlefield would become a prison.

By then, he would personally take action and cleanse all of Human Civilization’s Evolvers.

...

Suddenly—

In the distance, the Suspended Mountain Range that served as the base for Human Civilization’s Evolvers quickly rose into the air.

It charged toward the side of the Heiyuan Clan.

“Hmm?”

The monocled man’s expression changed slightly.

The Suspended Mountain Range was the base of Human Civilization on this battlefield.

It was also a weapon that could transform into a war fortress when necessary.

But clearly, now was not the time for that.

“What is that?”

The monocled man immediately noticed that with the collision of the Suspended Mountain Range,

countless Evolvers of Human Civilization started fleeing frantically in all directions using various means.

“Damn.”

The pitch-black thunder that flowed over the monocled man’s body suddenly began to boil.

Clearly,

the plans of his Heiyuan Clan, or perhaps the Insect Race, had been leaked.

Otherwise, these human Evolvers would not have started fleeing outright.

“Die.”

The monocled man took a step forward.

All around him, within a million miles, pitch-black thunder filled the space.

Hiss.

The monocled man raised his right hand and pressed it toward the oncoming Suspended Mountain Range.

“Merely ants.”

The monocled man’s gaze was cold,

and in an instant, the Suspended Mountain Range, which had become a war fortress, began to crumble rapidly.

“Hahahahaha.”

“Children of the Heiyuan Clan, I hope you can struggle to survive beneath the wrath of my Human Civilization…”

Inside the Suspended Mountain Range, Seventh Rank Monarch ‘Zhou Shi’ burst into mad laughter, then crumbled along with the Suspended Mountain Range.

The Suspended Mountain Range was too large, and as a war fortress, its target was too apparent,

it could only be left behind to attempt to cover the retreat, delaying the Heiyuan Clan.

But obviously, the monocled man’s strength was too terrifying,

almost reaching the peak of the Eighth Layer, he crushed the Suspended Mountain Range directly.

“They’ve all escaped?”

The monocled man looked toward the countless human Evolvers fleeing in all directions.

Being of high realm, the monocled man had long grasped the ‘instantaneous movement’ spatial model in the core space model.

But in the Battlefields of Different Races, spatial fluctuations were significant,

whether it was wormhole shuttling or spatial teleportation,

they both were likely to result in large errors or even getting lost in the depths of space.

Therefore, the monocled man could only rely on flight to give chase,

but the directions in which the numerous human Evolvers fled were all different, every which way, up and down, left and right.

Even if the monocled man truly pursued them, if he caught one and then returned,

the other Evolvers would have already run far away.

Once the Evolvers left the range of the battlefield, they could manipulate spaceships for wormhole shuttling.

At that time, the Heiyuan Clan would no longer have the ability to pursue and kill.

This was precisely why the Goddess of Freedom made the decision to have the human Evolvers escape.

Because this could allow eight or nine out of ten human Evolvers to survive.

As for the loss of many resources on the battlefield? It didn’t count for much.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Deep within the Thirteen Peaks Great Hall,

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“The Heiyuan Clan…”

Lin Yuan looked distantly toward the direction of the Battlefields of Different Races.

Everything experienced by the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, he naturally felt in sync.

“The higher-ups of Human Civilization should be aware of this by now…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In the Battlefields of Different Races’ Suspended Mountain Range, one could freely log into the Virtual World and connect with the Goddess of Freedom.

In such a circumstance, the moves of the Heiyuan Clan must have been transmitted.

“The Heiyuan Clan… the Insect Race?”

Lin Yuan didn’t know the specifics; he only speculated

that the actions of the Heiyuan Clan must be related to the Insect Race,

or perhaps they were directly instigated by them.

“If it really has to do with the Insect Race, then it’s not just one battlefield where this has happened…”

Lin Yuan conjectured in his heart; Peak Clans like the Insect Race wouldn’t engage in meaningless actions.

To merely seize one small-sized otherworldly battlefield? This would hardly have any effect on the overall battle situation.

…

Battlefields of Different Races.

“Run, run, run.”

“Run.”

Millions upon millions of human Evolvers, among whom were not a few of the Seventh Rank, and even the Sixth Rank constituted a considerable number, were fleeing desperately.

Faced with the command of the battlefield’s leader, these Evolvers had no doubts whatsoever.

Especially after seeing the leader ‘Zhou Shi’ driving the Suspended Mountain Range as a war fortress,

charging toward the Heiyuan Clan only to directly crumble afterward, they became even more desperate in their escape.

Among the fleeing Evolvers, many were Sixth Rank and even Seventh Rank Evolvers, some of whom had true bodies.

But even if the true bodies were safe for the time being outside, if the Avatars were to die,

it would still require a significant amount of time and energy to be re-condensed,

and the many treasures and weapons they carried would be lost.

So unless it was a moment of complete despair, no one would willingly give up.

…

“Without a complete blockade, at most only one or two out of ten human Evolvers can be stopped.”

The monocled man looked at the human Evolvers fleeing in all directions and quickly came to a conclusion.

The response speed of Human Civilization was just too fast,

If only they waited a little longer, until the blockade of the Heiyuan Clan was fully formed,

all Evolvers of Human Civilization would have no escape.

But for now,

according to the blockade range of the Heiyuan Clan powerhouses, they could probably hold back one or two out of ten Evolvers.

“Try to kill those Sixth Rank and Seventh Rank Evolvers…”

The monocled man quickly made a decision in his mind.

With only being able to hold back one or two out of ten human Evolvers as the big premise,

naturally, it was most cost-effective to leave behind those of the Sixth and Seventh Rank.

As for the Fourth and Fifth Rank… let them flee.
